issue_context.title: Unfocused Appearance editor doesn't appear on +, disappear on Deletion
issue_context.body:
### Windows Terminal version (or Windows build number)

1.11

### Other Software

_No response_

### Steps to reproduce

Add or remove an unfocused appearance.

### Expected Behavior

_No response_

### Actual Behavior

On add, the + changes to a [trash] icon, but I cannot scroll to reveal an unfocused appearance. It appears if i navigate away and back.

On delete, the [trash] icon changes to a +, but the UI doesn't disappear.
comments: Ah yes I didn't update the notifications we send to xaml when I added the til::feature, thanks for catching this!

review_comments: Why does this one notify a change for "UnfocusedAppearance" but `DeleteUnfocusedAppearance()` doesn't? 🤔
It's a fair question. If somebody were to be monitoring that object, it would have changed. We may want to notify on it just to be safe!
Mostly because it just wasn't necessary since XAML hides the entire control once it gets the `HasUnfocusedAppearance`/`ShowUnfocusedAppearance` update, but yeah I've added it just in case!
